description: v2.1.0 section 9.2 lists PrimitiveDef as one of the four ComponentDef union members ('ComponentDef := PrimitiveDef | ElementBundleDef | ExportedComponentDef | OffenseDef') but does not otherwise specify its shape. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged for review): modeled here as a bare, kind-tagged reference to a single GroundFactDef or LegalElementDef — the 'atomic predicate' case of ComponentDef, as opposed to a bundle/exported-component/whole-offense. This lets COMPOSE's components list (section 9.2) mix atomic predicates with bundles/offenses without a separate untagged-reference convention.

ref.description: Id of the referenced GroundFactDef or LegalElementDef.
